<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z ≈ 199, which in ESI positive mode is typically the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 197.99 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₉H₁₀O₅ (monoisotopic mass = 198.0528 Da, [M+H]⁺ = 199.0601 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula is C9H10O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O5</final_answer>
